---
title: "IFU Workflow"
---

## FITS to matrix

SpaxNMF expects a spaxel-by-wavelength matrix. For a FITS cube, the standard
workflow is to read the cube, reshape it, and clean invalid values before
fitting.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(FITSio)
library(SpaxNMF)

X <- readFITS("cube.fits")
Mat <- cube_to_matrix(X)
Mat[!is.finite(Mat)] <- 0
Mat <- pmax(Mat, 0)
```

## Fit and inspect

```{r, eval = FALSE}
fit <- spax_nmf(Mat, k = 5, lr = 0.01, niter = 5000)

plot(fit, type = "spectra")
plot(fit, type = "maps", nx = dim(X$imDat)[1], ny = dim(X$imDat)[2])
plot_reconstruction(fit, Mat, n = 6)
```

Example component-weight maps from the bundled synthetic cube:

![](images/simulated-maps.png)

## Reconstruction outputs

```{r, eval = FALSE}
maps <- predict(fit, type = "spatial")
cube_hat <- predict(
  fit,
  type = "cube",
  nx = dim(X$imDat)[1],
  ny = dim(X$imDat)[2]
)
resid <- residuals(
  fit,
  x = Mat,
  nx = dim(X$imDat)[1],
  ny = dim(X$imDat)[2]
)
```

## Metadata

When the input to `cube_to_matrix()` is a FITS-like list object, non-image
entries are carried forward as metadata. That metadata can be recovered from
the fitted object or reconstructed cube with `cube_metadata()`.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
fit <- spax_nmf(Mat, k = 5, lr = 0.01, niter = 5000)
cube_metadata(fit)
cube_metadata(cube_hat)
```

If redshift information is stored in the FITS-side metadata, it will now be
preserved as metadata and can be carried into fitted and reconstructed outputs.

## Comparative analyses

Public LOGCUBE products can be used to compare PCA, vanilla NMF, and spatial
NMF on the same target after matched preprocessing.

## Benchmark script

The repository also includes a real-cube diagnostic script that applies the
same preprocessing and figure style to external FITS cubes:

```bash
SPAXNMF_REAL_CUBE=/path/to/cube.fits \
SPAXNMF_REAL_OUTPUT=site/images/real-benchmark.png \
Rscript scripts/render_real_manga_diagnostic.R
```
